asb_ip.title: asb_ip
asb_ip.description: The IP address (or) the URL of ASB namespace

auth_type.title: auth_type
auth_type.description: The authentication mode to access the topic

connection_string.title: connection_string
connection_string.description: The connection string used for authentication. Required if the authentication type is `ConnectionString`

has_manage_permissions.title: has_manage_permissions
has_manage_permissions.description: The boolean value specifying whether the connection string has manage permissions

host_ip.title: host_ip
host_ip.description: The IP address of the host machine which we use to connect to ASB via ssh

host_user.title: host_user
host_user.description: The username on the host machine which we use to connect to ASB via ssh

message_type.title: message_type
message_type.description: The format of messages in the topic

namespace.title: namespace
namespace.description: The ASB namespace which we have to sync. Required for `AzureActiveDirectory` authentication.

schema_registry_key.title: schema_registry_key
schema_registry_key.description: The key used to access the schema registry. Required for the `avro` and `protobuf` message types

schema_registry_secret.title: schema_registry_secret
schema_registry_secret.description: The secret used to access the schema registry. Required for the `avro` and `protobuf` message types

schema_registry_urls.title: schema_registry_urls
schema_registry_urls.description: The comma-separated list of schema registry servers in the `server:port` format

subscriber_name.title: subscriber_name
subscriber_name.description: The subscriber name. If the connection string does not have manage permission, you need to specify a subscriber name we can use to fetch data. If not specified, we default to `fivetran_sub_<schema>`

sync_type.title: sync_type
sync_type.description: The sync type, which is based on the message type. For `text` and `xml`, `packed` is supported. For `protobuf` and `avro`, `unpacked` is supported. For `json`, both `packed` and `unpacked` are supported

topics.title: topics
topics.description: The comma-separated list of topics which should be synced. Required if you do not have manage permissions

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Azure application. Required if the authentication type is `AzureActiveDirectory`

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Azure application. Required if the authentication type is `AzureActiveDirectory`

refresh_token.description: The refresh token. Required if the authentication type is `AzureActiveDirectory`
